Class SizedWidget

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.common.SizedWidget
public final class SizedWidget extends Object
Pairs a Widget with optional explicit width and height dimensions.

This class allows specifying preferred dimensions for widgets in contexts where the widget itself doesn't provide size information. The sentinel value DEFAULT indicates "use the default" behavior (typically fill for width, 1 for height). 

// Widget with default dimensions
SizedWidget.of(myWidget)

// Widget with explicit height of 2 lines
SizedWidget.ofHeight(myWidget, 2)

// Widget with explicit width of 20 columns
SizedWidget.ofWidth(myWidget, 20)

// Widget with both dimensions specified
SizedWidget.of(myWidget, 20, 2)
